author: Marisa B
text:
I come here all the time, they have a great variety and such knowledgeable staff, so I would always recommend checking them out.

But specifically I wanted to highlight the fact that they saved my wedding day! 72 hours before my wedding I had a florist back out on our ceremony flowers. With such a short notice I headed here to see if they could help me out. Marianne and the staff were happy to help and completely knocked it out of the park! She did up 7 gorgeous baskets just like the inspiration photos I had shared. They lasted for the reception portion of our wedding which took place 2 weeks later as well. Nothing but positive things to say!

author: Justin Wong
text: Came for the first time. It's a lot bigger than you expect. Lots of parking, and nicely laid out. Plants are all very well taken care of so felt like you could buy with confidence. I like the prices based on the pot sizes and it's well labeled. Employees are very friendly and helpful, very knowledgeable about everything and can direct you as necessary. Credit and tap to pay options available, will be back again!

author: Debbie Bansley
text: I have attended here many times, and each time I have been met with fabulous service, knowledge and courtesy. I was in search of 10 hanging baskets. Jan assisted me and was SO VERY helpful. Her knowledge of the various baskets was amazing, and she made it fun for me! I walked out with 10 lovely baskets. I’ll be back!

author: Johanna Beal
text: I always love going to Listowel greenhouses. They are so very helpful, don't try to upsell and I have not lost any plants in the last 5 years that I have been going there
